definitions.explanation: A small cart that is pushed by hand, used for transporting goods, gardening materials, or other items. Includes wheelbarrows, handcarts, and similar manually-pushed vehicles.

examples.japanese: {手押|ておし}し{車|ぐるま}で{荷物|にもつ}を{運|はこ}んだ。
examples.english: I carried the luggage with a handcart.

examples.japanese: {畑|はたけ}で{手押|ておし}し{車|ぐるま}を{使|つか}って{土|つち}を{運|はこ}んだ。
examples.english: I used a wheelbarrow to transport soil in the field.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しのとき、{手押|ておし}し{車|ぐるま}があると{重|おも}い{段|だん}ボールを{運|はこ}ぶのに{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: When moving, a hand truck is convenient for carrying heavy cardboard boxes.

notes:
USAGE:
A general term for any cart that is pushed by hand. More specific types include:
- {一輪車|いちりんしゃ} (single-wheeled wheelbarrow)
- {台車|だいしゃ} (platform cart)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手押|ておし}し{車|ぐるま}を{押|お}す (to push a handcart)
- {手押|ておし}し{車|ぐるま}で{運|はこ}ぶ (to transport by handcart)
